title: Grounding, a first linear look: codec latents against the ground-truth labels
description: Step 4 of the plan (docs/methodology.md), before any formula search. For the fixed-width codecs at dropout 0.3 of release exp-codec-dropout-6 (2, 3, 4, 6, 12 and 16 latents, seeds 0 to 2), experiments/ground.py probe reports, on anchors of the validation links with fits made on anchors of the training links: how well each ground-truth label is predicted from the latents (linear, and quadratic in the latents), how much of each latent a linear fit on all labels explains, and how well one seed's latents predict another's at the same width. The labels and the messages come from release exp-steps-broad-30s-9, which has the arrival rates and the number of active flows. It is the same campaign as the data these codecs were trained on (exp-phase0-steps-2), run again: the links and the split are the same, but most episodes are not byte for byte the same, so this is a first look and the probe is to be repeated on codecs trained on this release. A linear probe is a lower bound on what the latents hold. The test links are not read.
